test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Arunima Sinha / is first amputee / to scale / Mount Everest.
solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Arunima Sinha / is first amputee / to scale / Mount Everest." contains an error in usage of an article.
 
• The error is in the segment, "is first amputee". According to grammar rules, an article (like 'the' or 'a') is needed before "first amputee".
 
• Therefore, option 2, "is first amputee" is the part of the sentence that contains the error.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "Mount Everest" This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• Option 3: "Arunima Sinha" This part of the sentence is also correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• Option 4: "to scale" This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.
